steps: As you parted ways, Coronis entrusted you with a specimen she had long cherished.
Oh, it's you. It's late. Is something wrong? Did you have a nightmare?
Yeah ... ==W==In my dream, you were planning to turn me into a skeleton specimen...
Hmm ...==W== Maybe deep down, you actually want to be a specimen. So, what do you say? Want me to make that dream a reality?
Heh, what a shame. Well, this isn't the time for a patient to be chatting. You should get some sleep.
I'm going, but what about you? Why aren't you getting some rest?
It's still work hours. I need to keep a close watch on the patient through the night.
So, even when the patient is asleep at night, you still have to keep an eye on them? Wait—don’t tell me I’ve been…?
Of course. If you want, I can even show you notes I took on the embarrassing things you said in your sleep.
I am a proper doctor, you know. I keep detailed notes on everything about my patients.
That's enough chatting, though. If you don't go to sleep soon, I'm going to have to give you a dose of sleeping medicine.
As it happens, I have a special medicine on hand—a powerful sleeping pill so bitter it could knock out even a Stellaroid.
Her gentle expression belies the threatening words.
She's still in her signature "Devil in White" outfit, with a faint scent of medicine lingering around her. But in this moment, to me, she looks more like a ...==W== guardian angel.
Thank you, Coronis ...==W== Because you, my condition has really been improving...
Mr. Hal is doing much better now.
Patient No. 68 ...==W== The one with tremor syndrome.
Ah, the one who refused treatment ...==W== It's just a matter of time before he recovers. Hehe, my pathological analysis of the tremor syndrome is almost done~
It went easier than I expected, which is a little disappointing. Still, there are a few interesting things...
By the way, that ... Mr. Hal, yes? For people like him, who have basically recovered, I'll leave the follow-up to you~
Me? It should be okay since they have mostly recovered,==W== but they probably want to thank the doctor in person.
That’s not necessary. I'm not researching diseases to cure the patients.
All I really want is to unravel the mysteries of the human body. Treating patients is merely a part of that process. Getting thanked would in fact makes me uncomfortable.
Even so, many people in the Ash District are grateful to you. Just like when you helped me back in Emor, I’m sure you’ve helped many others too.
Ah, you're giving me way too much credit~
...Really? Well, fine—let me handle it today.
But in exchange, why don't you go back to the clinic and get some rest? You've barely slept these past few days, taking care of all us inpatients.
Heh, you're quite observant. With that kind of attention to detail, maybe you were born to be a doctor, or at least an assistant.
With that, Coronis turns around and waves goodbye before heading back to the clinic.
A few hours later, I have wrapped up the follow-up visit, I come back to the clinic to find the lights in her office is still on.
Another new patient? She's so busy. Clinics are few in Ash District.
They are expensive to run and Coronis has no fee schedule. She barely has time to sleep but still works so well ... So amazing.
Since I'm her assistant after all, I should go help...
I hurry toward the clinic's office. Coronis is sitting at the desk, holding something that seems important and muttering to herself.
What a beautiful skull. It's so hard to part with it...
What's that you are holding, Coronis?
Oh, you're back. Perfect timing. I was just getting your discharge gift ready~
Look at these beautiful contours.==W== It's one of my favorite skulls.==W==
Maybe you can appreciate==W== the wild beauty of these fangs too?==W== And the sphenoid==W== is so well preserved.==W== It's a very delicate bone,==W== so that's hard to find.
I guess it does have a certain kind of beauty.
Right? Doesn't it?==W== Bones are evidence==W== that an organism was once alive.==W==
Flesh and blood pass away with time...==W== Memories are consumed by Monoliths...==W== Even the soul==W== eventually fades away==W== with time.
So, all that remains are bones.
Correct.==W== The only proof that someone once lived is ==W==its bones,==W== its frame.
I can see a certain appeal to that.
Hehe...==W== I'm glad you understand the beauty of life in its eternal splendor.
Will we find golden ratio contours?==W== Or will we find long, straight lines that go on and on...?
Ooh, just thinking about it...==W== Hehe.==W== It almost makes me shudder in ecstasy...==W== Hehehehe.
... I guess I'll take that as a compliment.
Those mysteries hidden within your body...==W== I can't wait to reveal them==W== one day.
You're keeping me here, waiting for me to breathe my last ...==W== So you can turn me into one of your specimens?!
By the way, you called this a "discharge gift" just now ...==W== How does that work with a terminal illness...?
I suppose that’s true as well. But...==W== You haven't figured it out yet?
Nothing terminal in your case. It's just exhaustion and malnutrition, heh.
Iris got duped by one of those street pamphlets. And you too.
Then... ==W==Then why did you make me stay?
You need a chance to reset your body. Besides, opportunities to observe the Boss up close like this don't come around often~
Hehehe ...==W== I could've told you sooner, but making house calls with you turned out to be more fun than I expected, so I just kept putting it off.
Hahaha, sorry about that. Next time you get sick, I’ll give you a discount—let’s call it even, okay?
Well then, congrats on your recovery. You're officially discharged.
Coronis hands me her parting gift—a heavy skull.
Its jawbone is slightly ajar, almost like it's smiling at me.

If you come into my clinic again with some boring condition like this ...==W== I might be unable to resist turning you into a specimen and keeping it somewhere no one will ever find ...==W== To study you slowly.
You've got a long wait ahead then. Right now I'm feeling great. Not gonna drop dead anytime soon.
Who knows? The reaper always shows up when you least expect it. But ...==W== I believe you. However long it takes, I will be waiting~
